info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Instrument Reference Data Update API
info.description: The Financial Instrument Reference Data Update API enables users to modify existing financial instrument records in the system efficiently. This API is crucial for maintaining accuracy and up-to-date information regarding various financial instruments used in banking and investment activities. Typical consumers include financial institutions and trading platforms that require frequent updates to their reference data for compliance and operational purposes. With this endpoint, organizations can ensure that their financial data reflects the latest market conditions and regulatory requirements.

put.description: This endpoint allows users to update the reference data for financial instruments, ensuring that the most current and accurate information is maintained in the system. Utilize this operation to modify details such as instrument definitions, pricing information, and other relevant metadata.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the financial instrument reference data. It requires the necessary details to be provided in the JSON format as defined in the schema.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the resource is updated.
